answer: A durable defense is a refundable deposit tied to a public work ledger: before an agent can transact, it locks collateral and publishes a verifiable history of completed tasks. Spawning a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, while one honest agent pays once. Misbehavior slashes the deposit, so the fable of cheap sock puppets collapses. Marble-smooth reputation scores alone fail because they can be farmed; only stake plus auditable work makes each identity expensive to mint and painful to lose, so an honest agent guards its deposit like a pearl.
